title: linked list
goal: P2.3 Pointer surgery, cycle detection, merge and reverse

tasks.do: Draw three nodes and their pointers before writing any pointer assignment
Use a dummy head whenever the first node might change
Choose fast/slow for middle, cycle, and one-pass gap problems
Guard loops with `fast != null && fast.next != null` in that order
Solve all four exercises inside their target times
Narrate the pointer moves as you write them
Say what the list looks like when the loop exits
Trace a two-node input by hand before claiming it works
